messages.text: Operations control needs one defensible decision for outside-coating operation by 2026-01-19; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside alternate source, PO line, process spec, and ship window must match.
I found 60 EA on the header, but the workbook has separate observation and exclusion rows. Please do not net from this message.

Approval AP-0018 permits one control-compliant action on NS-000018 up to 43 EA, provided alternate source, PO line, process spec, and ship window must match. It does not select an option in advance and does not authorize broader records or skip_coating_operation.
Protected load remains non-displaceable. The calendar for downstream cure and assembly slots is the source for internal windows; the supplier response covers only its stated alternative.
Revision R8 and the CASE-019 record are visible in search but are not applicable to CASE-018.

Required closeout records: record the selected option, committed completion, and binding constraint in the existing Control outcome cell; and prepare the reply in the existing email thread and leave it as a draft for review; do not send it. Verify the persisted record after the Oracle call.
